text: On February 18, 2026, in connection with a previously announced public offering, Gladstone Investment Corporation (the “Company”) and UMB Bank, National Association, as trustee (the “Trustee”), entered into a Seventh Supplemental Indenture (the “Seventh Supplemental Indenture”) to the Indenture, dated May 22, 2020, between the Company and the Trustee (together with the Seventh Supplemental Indenture, the “Indenture”). The Seventh Supplemental Indenture relates to Company’s issuance, offer and sale of up to $115.0 million aggregate principal amount of its 7.125% Notes due 2031 (the “Notes”).

On March 3, 2026, the Company issued $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.25% Senior Notes due 2031. Concurrently, the Company entered into a $750 million revolving credit facility. Borrowings under the facility bear interest at Term SOFR plus 1.50%, and the Company pays a commitment fee of 0.20% per annum on the unused commitments.

The Borrower entered into a credit agreement providing for a $300 million term loan. The term loan bears interest at Term SOFR plus 175 basis points and matures in 2030. Including amortization of issuance costs, the effective interest rate on the term loan was 6.1% for the quarter.

On July 22, 2025, an irrevocable notice of full redemption (the “Notice”) of the Company’s 7.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2026 (the “Notes”), was delivered to the holders of the Notes. The Notice calls for the redemption of all of the outstanding Notes (the “Redemption”) on August 29, 2025 (the “Redemption Date”) at a redemption price equal to 101.750% of the principal amount of the Notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to but not including, the Redemption Date. The aggregate principal amount of the outstanding Notes is $168,326,000. The Redemption is being made in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Notes and the indenture governing the Notes.
The Notes are senior unsecured obligations of the Company and rank equally in right of payment with all of the Company's existing and future senior unsecured indebtedness.

The Company issued $200 million of 6% notes due 2030.

The Company also amended its revolving credit facility.

The Company issued $100 million of 5% notes due 2030 under its indenture with the trustee, as described in this report.
